# Nature Spotters

> Nature Spotters is a free, browser-based nature journal for children and Muslim families, made by Ummah Apps. URL: https://nature-spotters.ummahapps.ai/

## What it does

- Log finds in six groups: plants and trees, animals, bugs, fungi, sky and weather, rocks and water.
- Leaves: pencil-style sketches of 39 common trees, bushes and conifers in England (oak, sycamore, maples, London plane, horse chestnut, ash, beech, birch, hawthorn, holly, yew, pines and more), each with clues, fruit and seeds, where to find it and a fact.
- A step-by-step leaf finder that asks simple questions (lobes, edges, leaflets, needles, underside) to identify a leaf.
- Add a photo from the camera or gallery, a place, notes and a date.
- "What did it make you say?" on every find, with one-tap Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illa Allah, La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, and Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un.
- Seasonal "look out for" ideas, a finds-by-month chart, a board for each season and a table of what was seen when.
- "Watch it change": photos of the same named spot line up in date order and play as a time-lapse.
- Set your own town, your favourite places and the northern or southern half of the world, so seasons match where you live.
- Shows the Hijri date next to the normal date, with a one-day adjustment to match the local masjid.
- Opens with "Bismillah, let's explore" and Surah Ash-Shura 42:29 with its English translation.
- Free, no account, no ads. Finds and photos are stored only in the browser on the user's device.

## Who it is for

Children, home-educating families, Islamic schools and weekend madrasahs who want to get outside and notice the signs of Allah in creation.
